correctness.rationale: The explicit eleven-vertex bipartite graph has five blue and six red vertices, eighteen edges, and red degree three. Both endpoints of a spanning path are red; four distinct Pósa moves follow. An independently written exhaustive red-start DFS recovered exactly 222 reversal classes. A separate construction of the complete rotation graph recovered 444 edges and eccentricities 8:198 and 9:24, connected from every root. The enumeration has no truncation; a one-edge exchange rejoining two split paths is an endpoint rotation because there is no Hamiltonian cycle.
residual_risks: Finite calculations certify only the specified finite objects or bounded corroboration; all-size claims depend on inspected arguments.
